items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: The first time Lips Page heard me, he said, "Goddamn, where did this cat come from playing like an ofay, man?"

ctx.x: But that has surprised some people when you've mentioned that. But I guess those records were pretty hip at that time.

Well, I liked them, because those were what I was exposed to. It's a funny thing. The first time Lips Page heard me, he said, "Goddamn, where did this cat come from playing like an ofay, man?" But I was playing like Bix, you know! Things like that. And plus, playing like a saxophone, which put me away from the trumpet, with the split notes and the Louis Armstrong scene, you know, that... So it was a little strange to hear me!
You said you met Lips pretty early.
